def test_runtime_mismatch_refuses(self):
        port = self.port()
        self.baseline(invocation="1" * 32, exit_monotonic=100)
        self.unit_path.write_bytes(_node_unit())
        self.source.complete("2" * 32, 200)
        with self.assertRaises(completion.CompletionRefused):
            port.read(UNIT, "python", 100)
evidence.reason: The test at lines 307-313 constructs the port before rewriting the unit to the Node unit. Since `self.port()` captures the Python unit digest at line 308, the later rewrite at line 310 changes both the runtime and the unit digest. The expected `CompletionRefused` can therefore be produced by the digest guard alone, so the test does not isolate runtime recognition; it would still pass if runtime mismatch recognition were broken. The separate digest-mismatch test at lines 299-305 confirms the digest guard exists, supporting the finding.
